newsitem.title: USA: U.S. looks for further reforms in Serbia.
newsitem.headline: U.S. looks for further reforms in Serbia.

text.p: The United States on Friday welcomed the Serbian opposition's takeover of the Belgrade city council but said it was looking for further reforms from the Serbian government including media independence.

The opposition Zajedno coalition took control of the capital on Friday after the socialist government reversed its cancellation of Nov. 17 election results that Zajedno won in Belgrade and 13 other cities.
"We welcome this move as an important step in the right direction," said State Department spokesman Glyn Davies.
"We expect that municipal assets including local broadcast media are fairly transferred and that the Serbian government will work constructively with the new city governments."

But, he told reporters, "we're looking for further signs that the Serbian government is willing to enact significant democratic reform and we renew our call on the Serbian government to initiate a meaningful dialogue with the democratic opposition."
The agenda, Davies said, should include independence of the media -- much of it currently state-controlled -- and electoral reform.
